def send(rcpt, mid, subject):
    msg=f'From: postreboot@branch.test\r\nTo: {rcpt}\r\nSubject: {subject}\r\nMessage-ID: <{mid}>\r\n\r\nPost-restart verification.\r\n'
    with smtplib.SMTP(h,25,timeout=10) as s:
        print(rcpt+'_refused='+repr(s.sendmail('postreboot@branch.test',[rcpt],msg)))
def probe(rcpt):
    with smtplib.SMTP(h,25,timeout=10) as s:
        s.ehlo(); s.mail('postreboot@branch.test'); return s.rcpt(rcpt)
send('helpdesk@branch.test','postreboot-helpdesk@branch.test','Post-restart helpdesk test')
send('accounts@branch.test','postreboot-accounts@branch.test','Post-restart accounts test')
print('unknown='+repr(probe('definitely-missing-recipient@branch.test')))
print('relay='+repr(probe('target@unrelated.invalid')))
